Name: Bonster's Rare Crops Retexture
Author: 0torin
Description:
This is a retexture mod that reskins the assets (including item sprites, growth sprites and seed sprites) for the 29 field crops in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8523]Bonster's Rare Crops & Oddi-trees[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61875811]rjgilber [/url] as of their v 1.1.0. Please note that this file only contains the sprites; so it won't do anything on its own. You'll need to download the Bonster's Rare Crops file from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8523?tab=files&file_id=40426]here[/url] first. Please note that the Oddi-trees file is [u][b]not[/b][/u] required to use this mod!

[b]Installation[/b]:
1) Install the Rare Crops file from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8523]Bonster's Rare Crops & Oddi-trees[/url], and all its dependencies.
2) Download this mod, and unzip.
3) Drag and drop this mod's two folders into the "Bonster's Fruits & Veggies Part 2" folder.
4) Click "Replace All Files".

[b]Thanks to[/b]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61875811]rjgilber[/url] for their amazing, extensive mods adding so many more unique crops to the game, and for permitting retextures! Their icons were used as the base for many of these assets.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url] whose [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4435]Bonster's Crops and Recipes Retexture[/url] mod I referenced for how to organize the files in this retexture.
ConcernedApe for Stardew, and whose original trellis and garden pot sprites were used as a base for several assets.

[b]Future Plans:[/b]
Retexturing the Oddi-trees from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8523]Bonster's Rare Crops & Oddi-trees[/url]
Potentially retexturing newer assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3438]Bonster's Crops[/url] introduced in version 2.0
May eventually rework this retexture, as there are several sprites I feel could be adjusted~~
